meta.name: seo-image-gen
meta.description: AI image generation for SEO assets: OG/social preview images, blog hero images, schema images, product photography, infographics. Powered by Gemini via nanobanana-mcp. Requires banana extension installed. Use when user says "generate image", "OG image", "social preview", "hero image", "blog image", "product photo", "infographic", "seo image", "create visual", "image-gen", "favicon", "schema image", "pinterest pin", "generate visual", "banner", or "thumbnail".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为网站或社交媒体快速生成SEO优化的图片
copy.tagline_en: Generate AI images for SEO assets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create SEO-optimized images for your website or social media

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成 SEO 图片，如社交媒体预览图、博客头图、产品照片、信息图等。生成后还会给出 alt 文本、文件命名、WebP 转换等优化建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“生成图片”、“OG 图片”、“博客头图”、“产品照片”等关键词时，或直接使用 /seo image-gen 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张博客头图，主题是人工智能的未来。
生成一张产品照片，白色背景，展示新款智能手表。
say.note: Claude 会生成 4:3 比例、白色背景的产品图。

say.text: 为这篇文章生成一张 OG 社交预览图，尺寸 1200x630。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate SEO images based on your description, such as social preview images, blog hero images, product photos, and infographics. It also provides optimization tips like alt text, file naming, and WebP conversion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "generate image", "OG image", "hero image", "product photo", etc., or use the /seo image-gen command.

say_en.text: Generate a blog hero image about the future of AI.
say_en.note: Claude will create a 16:9 widescreen image and provide SEO tips.

say_en.text: Create a product photo with white background for a new smartwatch.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a 4:3 product image with studio lighting.

say_en.text: Make an OG social preview image for this article, 1200x630.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a 16:9 preview and remind about og:meta tags.
